newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: FORECAST-Slovenia '96 inflation seen at 8.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Slovenia '96 inflation seen at 8.5 pct.

text.p: Slovenian Prime Minister Janez Drnovsek said on Friday the country's 1996 inflation rate was expected to be between eight and nine percent, compared with last year's 8.6 percent.

"Although inflation was very high at the start of the year, current figures are low and show that 1996 inflation will be between eight and nine percent," Drnovsek said after meeting a delegation of the European Parliament.
In September, year-on-year inflation fell to 9.4 percent from 10.3 percent a month earlier. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
